purpose: Additive new-game opening stock and factory asset baseline. This policy creates explicitly simulated gameplay stock and factory assets from existing country profiles, existing 41 resource identities, existing mine-site scenario records, existing 21 factory profiles, and the approved factory-input stock baseline. It never converts simulated geological reserves into warehouse stock or claims a startup asset or stock is an observed real-world facility or delivery.

openingStock.factoryInputSource: Existing operational catalog factory recipe input × rated daily capacity

factoryInputStockBaseline.alternativeRecipePolicy: Split a factory type's country starting units among its canonical alternative recipes; prioritize defaultRecipeId for any remainder. Never count every alternative route as if the same factory runs them simultaneously.
factoryInputStockBaseline.universalProcessorPolicy: Allocate universal processor units by the country's commercial mine-resource site-count mix; use explicitly labeled simulated opening-import inputs only where no commercial domestic site exists.
factoryInputStockBaseline.rawResourceNamespace: Keep the canonical 41 raw resource identities unchanged.
factoryInputStockBaseline.intermediateProductNamespace: Keep processed industrial intermediates separate from the canonical raw-resource identity set.
factoryInputStockBaseline.externalSectorInputPolicy: One-time simulated opening stock is calculated from the configured daily factory input demand and target coverage days. It is not observed agriculture/livestock output, a verified import delivery, or a recurring supply contract.
factoryInputStockBaseline.warehousePolicy: Add RAW rows to the raw warehouse and INTERMEDIATE rows to the processed warehouse. Update aggregate inventory, unit map, batch, lot, receipt, and inventory ledger together. Top up only the measured gap between current inventory and the target.
factoryInputStockBaseline.unitPolicy: Respect an existing inventory unit only through an explicit catalog simulation unit bridge; preserve unknown or incompatible unit states as reported gaps.

startupFactories.eligibleSiteRule: commercialExtraction === true AND resourceId belongs to canonical 41-resource profile set AND matching processingRules entry exists
startupFactories.downstreamFactoryEligibility: A downstream factory may be seeded only when at least the configured minimum number and fraction of its recipe input identities have existing production sources in this country. Other recipe inputs remain explicit external dependencies; startup-factory asset creation does not fabricate them as observed deliveries. The separate approved factory-input baseline is explicitly simulated opening stock and does not represent upstream production or import settlement.
startupFactories.externalSectorInputs: Do not create observed agriculture, livestock, or other non-resource-sector production or import transactions. Factory-input opening allocations, when enabled by factoryInputStockBaseline, remain separately marked as simulated one-time startup inventory.
startupFactories.outputAuthority: Existing catalog recipe only; startup assets receive no fabricated input batches or finished goods

simulatedUtilities.capacityBasis: Sum of existing catalog utility requirements of newly seeded operational starter assets × reserveMultiplier
